title: 第3章 此子与我有缘
novel_title: 重生官场：我真的不想再升职了
content_zh:
“我觉得我还能再抢救一下！”

    梁惟石话音刚落，负责计分的小姑娘就不由自主地噗嗤一笑。随后惊觉场合不对，连忙咬着嘴唇低下了头。

    沈晴岚的笑点没那么低，但也是忍不住扬了下唇角。

    同时她也注意到，赵书记正饶有兴致地注视着那道年轻的身影，神情之中似乎透露出几分欣赏的意味。

    相比之下，主考官刘运生等人的心情却是异常的阴郁。

    眼见对方不慌不忙从容应对，刘运生也只能按照程序作出解释，随后问出了这场面试中的最后一题。

    “十七号考生，请用‘朋友’‘摇晃’‘夜晚’‘公园’‘凶恶’五个词语编一则小故事，你有一分钟的思考时间……”

    刘运生虎视眈眈地盯着十七号考生，他就不信这个邪，他倒要看看，这小子能不能把这个故事编出花来。

    串词编故事，意在测查考生的逻辑思维、发散思维、语言组织和快速反应方面的能力。

    它并不是简单地将五个词语串联起来了事，而是需要所编故事具备立意的正确性，情节的合理性，故事的完整性。

    除此之外，想要得高分，还需要令人眼前一亮的新颖性。

    梁惟石稍经思索，缓缓开口说道：“那是一个月上柳梢头的‘夜晚’，我和女‘朋友’相约在青山‘公园’，划过夜空的朵朵烟花，照亮了女友的容颜，我们相拥在一起，享受着属于我们的甜蜜时间。

    忽然，女友的爸爸偷偷出现，露出了‘凶恶’的嘴脸。

    他一把揪住我领口，一边‘摇晃’一边吼——看你长得那么丑，怎么会有女朋友？

    然后不分青红皂白，上来就是一拳头。

    我蓦然从梦中惊醒，这才发现，原来，我确实没有女朋友！”

    鹅鹅鹅……一阵不合时宜的笑声，清晰的从计分席处传出。

    又是笑点贼低的小姑娘，她是想忍，但是没忍住。

    刘运生阴着脸，瞪了小姑娘一眼，心说要不是看你大伯的面子，高低得训你两句不可。

    实际上，不只小姑娘没忍住，包括几个考官，以及监督席的工作人员都有些忍俊不禁。

    沈晴岚脸上闪过一抹浅笑，但随即又变得若有所思。

    不到一分钟的时间，就能够创作出这样一篇立意新颖，构思巧妙的小故事，而更加出彩的，是其运用诙谐风趣的言语描写，再配合意想不到的情节转折，达到了令人会心一笑的幽默效果。

    这样的表现，已经不能简单地用‘优秀’来形容了。
content_en:
"I think I can still save a little more!"

As soon as Liang Weishi finished speaking, the little girl in charge of scoring couldn't help but chuckle.Then he was shocked to realize that the situation was not right, and he quickly bit his lip and lowered his head.

Shen Qinglan's smile was not that low, but she couldn't help but raise the corners of her lower lips.

At the same time, she also noticed that Secretary Zhao was watching the young figure with great interest, and there seemed to be some appreciation in his expression.

In contrast, the mood of the examiner Liu Yunsheng and others was extremely gloomy.

Seeing that the other party responded calmly and calmly, Liu Yunsheng could only explain according to the procedure, and then asked the last question in the interview.

"Candidate No. 17, please make up a short story using five words: 'friend', 'shaking', 'night', 'park' and 'evil'. You have one minute to think..."

Liu Yunsheng stared at Candidate No. 17 with eager eyes. He did not believe in this evil. He wanted to see if this boy could make up this story.

The purpose of stringing words together to make up stories is to test the candidates' abilities in logical thinking, divergent thinking, language organization and quick response.

It is not simply a matter of stringing together five words, but the story needs to have the correctness of the idea, the rationality of the plot, and the completeness of the story.

In addition, to get high scores, you also need eye-catching novelty.

After thinking for a moment, Liang Weishi slowly said: "It was a 'night' in the willow trees on a moonlit night. My girlfriend and I met in Qingshan 'Park'. The fireworks across the night sky lit up my girlfriend's face. We hugged each other and enjoyed our sweet time.

Suddenly, my girlfriend's father secretly appeared with a 'vicious' face.

He grabbed me by the collar, shook me and shouted - You look so ugly, how come you have a girlfriend?

Then he came up with a fist indiscriminately.

I suddenly woke up from my dream and realized that I really don’t have a girlfriend!"

Goose goose... A burst of inappropriate laughter could be heard clearly from the scoring table.

Another little girl with a bad sense of humor. She wanted to hold it back, but she couldn't.

Liu Yunsheng had a sullen face and glared at the little girl, thinking that if it wasn't for the sake of your uncle, he would have to scold you.

In fact, not only the little girl couldn't hold it back, but also several examiners and the staff at the supervisory table couldn't help but laugh.

A slight smile flashed across Shen Qinglan's face, but then she became thoughtful again.

In less than a minute, you can create such a novel and cleverly conceived short story, and what’s even more outstanding is its use of humorous language descriptions, combined with unexpected plot twists, to achieve a humorous effect that makes people smile.

This kind of performance can no longer be simply described as 'excellent'.
